title: UncloakFeatureSchemaV1
description: Unified and frozen feature schema contract for Uncloak v1.0 inference and modern lab training.

unit_of_analysis.window: Sliding window of N consecutive application bursts (minimum 10 bursts before ML inference)

features.name: n_bursts
features.description: Number of observed communication bursts in the sliding window. Gating threshold: >= 10 bursts required before evaluating probability.

features.name: iat_median
features.description: Median of inter-arrival times (IAT) between successive bursts. Serves as robust sleep interval estimator.

features.name: iat_mad_ratio
features.description: Normalized Median Absolute Deviation of inter-arrival times. Robust replacement for CV against outliers and network delays.

features.name: iat_iqr_ratio
features.description: Normalized Interquartile Range of inter-arrival times. Secondary robust dispersion metric.

features.name: iat_bowley_skew
features.description: Bowley skewness coefficient. Evaluates asymmetry in the inter-arrival distribution to separate uniform vs multiplicative jitter.

features.name: size_out_median
features.description: Median number of outbound bytes transmitted per burst.

features.name: size_in_median
features.description: Median number of inbound bytes received per burst.

features.name: size_mad_ratio
features.description: Normalized Median Absolute Deviation of outbound payload sizes. Quantifies heartbeat regularity.

features.name: conn_per_burst
features.description: Ratio of distinct TCP connections to bursts. Distinguishes ephemeral HTTP(S) check-ins from long-lived persistent tunnels.

features.name: raw_ip_flag
features.description: Host-side DNS correlation flag. Set to 1 if the process established a connection to an IP address without prior local DNS resolution.

features.name: proc_signed
features.description: Authenticode digital signature verification via WinVerifyTrust (wintrust.dll). 1 if cryptographically valid and trusted, 0 otherwise.

features.name: proc_path_class
features.description: Binary filesystem location classification: 0 = System/Program Files, 1 = AppData/Local, 2 = Temp/Downloads/Public, 3 = Unresolved/Exited.

label.name: label
label.description: 0 = Benign background traffic, 1 = Confirmed C2 beacon flow (training and benchmarking only).
